correctness.rationale: The categorical graph C8×K3 has 24 vertices with edges exactly at adjacent cycle coordinates and unequal colors. Independent enumeration reconstructs precisely 18,722 faces and the stated face vector. The recorded pivot sequence matches 9,358 face pairs; an independently formed reversal of all 104,592 Hasse edges is acyclic, leaving two degree-4 and four degree-5 critical faces. Independent integral Morse projection gives differential [[-1,0,0,1],[-1,0,0,1]], a primitive rank-one map, yielding Htilde4=Z and Htilde5=Z^3 and the wedge S4∨3 S5. Independent signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz sums for ALL 96 D8×S3 elements agree with χ4−χ5 for χ4=(-1)^(a+b)sgnσ, χ5=(-1)^a sgnσ #Fixσ. The inspected full source explicitly lifts critical cycles and tests separate degree-four/five action traces for all 96. These finite integer calculations cover the entire 24-vertex object, not an extrapolated family.
